name: Ogata Honami
source:
A medical doctor, and relative of [url=/c60493]Ogata Monami[/url].

Unlike her appearance, she seems to be a good doctor. She not only consults about illness, but also provides advice to the main characters.

Her age is unknown. No one knows her age or past.
